# Mark Simonsen, CPA
> Professional profile of Mark Simonsen, CPA -- founding principal of AE Tax Advisors' Mountain West region.

## About
Mark Simonsen is a Certified Public Accountant and the founding principal of AE Tax Advisors' Mountain West region, based in Billings, Montana. He specializes in proactive tax planning, cost segregation studies, entity structuring, and multi-state tax strategy for business owners and real estate investors. Mark leads the firm's engineering-based cost segregation practice and has completed over 500 studies.
